EventTitle: Struck by animal, unspecified
text: An employee was moving cows from one pen to another when he became caught between a cow and a post, breaking a rib, puncturing a lung, and suffering a chest contusion.

EventTitle: Kicked by animal
text: An employee was walking behind pack mules on a trail when a mule kicked the employee's chest, causing a contusion that required hospitalization.

EventTitle: Other animal bites, nonvenomous
text: On 3/7/16, an employee using the mobile vet clinic was hospitalized with an infection after being bitten by a cat.

EventTitle: Hitting, kicking, beating, shoving
text: A guard was hit in the head, neck and chest by a combative patient in the emergency room.

EventTitle: Stings and venomous bites
text: An employee was completing a request to remove a rattlesnake from an office building when it bit his left thumb, resulting in swelling.

EventTitle: Stings and venomous bites
text: An employee reached into an open trench to straighten some conduit and was bitten on the left-hand finger by a venomous snake.

EventTitle: Intentional injury by other person, unspecified
text: An employee was struck by a patient and knocked to the floor, requiring hospitalization and surgery on her neck and back.

EventTitle: Bites and stings, unspecified
text: An employee was participating in an obstacle course at Fort Bliss when he went over an obstacle and felt an insect bite his right index finger.

EventTitle: Hitting, kicking, beating, shoving
text: An employee was driving to a service call when individuals in Halloween masks stopped the vehicle and assaulted the employee. The employee suffered a broken jaw and facial laceration.

EventTitle: Other animal bites, nonvenomous
text: An employee was cleaning out a cat room from the night before when she tried to pick up a cat, and the cat bit her left hand. The bite became infected and required hospitalization that evening.

EventTitle: Part of occupant s body caught between vehicle and other object in nonroadway transport incident
text: An employee was driving a forklift. The forklift skidded on wet concrete while turning and stuck a skid of material. The employee's left arm was caught and fractured between the forklift and the skid.

EventTitle: Pedestrian struck by vehicle in nonroadway area, unspecified
text: An employee was walking into a warehouse when they were struck by a forklift. They sustained a foot/leg fracture.

EventTitle: Fall or jump from vehicle in normal operation, nonroadway
text: An employee was riding an ATV when he came to a terrain that induced a sudden stop. He was thrown over the handle bars and landed on the ground, dislocating his wrists and requiring surgery.

EventTitle: Pedestrian struck by forward-moving vehicle in roadway
text: An employee was crossing the street with a client when a vehicle struck the employee. The employee sprained the bi-lateral knee, neck, and left and right shoulders.

EventTitle: Nonroadway noncollision  fall or jump from moving vehicle
text: A temporary employee was standing on a golf cart when it made a turn and she lost balance and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a concussion.

EventTitle: Nonroadway noncollision  fall or jump from and struck by moving vehicle
text: An employee stepped onto the track of a bulldozer to speak to the operator. The dozer moved forward, and the employee fell between the track and the blade. They sustained injuries to their pelvis and legs.

EventTitle: Part of occupant s body caught between vehicle and other object in nonroadway transport incident
text: An employee was attempting to make a U-turn on a forklift when her foot was caught and fractured between the forklift and a pallet rack.

EventTitle: Pedestrian vehicular incident, unspecified
text: A road grader struck an employee that was performing surveying work. The employee suffered a broken hip, a broken right foot/ankle, and possibly broken ribs and was hospitalized.

EventTitle: Nonroadway collision with other vehicle, unspecified
text: An employee was driving a forklift around a corner when he attempted to adjust his forks. He then hit another forklift driver, lacerating his calf on the forks of the second lift.

EventTitle: Pedestrian struck by vehicle in nonroadway area, unspecified
text: An employee was struck by a service van in the parking lot resulting in a broken femur.

EventTitle: Vehicle or machinery fire
text: An employee was operating a tractor when the engine overheated and caught fire. The employee sustained burns and smoke inhalation.

EventTitle: Ignition of vapors, gases, or liquids
text: An employee was filling the pressure washer with gas. The tank slipped from his hand and fuel splashed onto his legs. The gas was ignited by the hot engine and one of the employee's legs was burned.

EventTitle: Ignition of vapors, gases, or liquids
text: An employee was filling a power washer with gasoline when combustion occurred. The employee was hospitalized for flash burns to his face.

EventTitle: Ignition of vapors, gases, or liquids
text: An employee was ventilating a building containing a gas leak and the gases ignited when the employee opened the door. The employee suffered first degree burns to the face and neck and second degree burns to both hands.

EventTitle: Fire or explosion, unspecified
text: An employee was starting up an aluminum sweat furnace when he received burns on his arm and elbow.

EventTitle: Fire, unspecified
text: An employee was working on a pipe at a steel producing facility. Flammable material inside the pipe ignited, causing burns to the employee's face and torso.

EventTitle: Explosion, n.e.c.
text: An employee was providing security services at a client location when a spare lithium-ion rechargeable flashlight battery exploded in his right pocket causing second-degree burns to his thigh.

EventTitle: Fire, unspecified
text: While shoveling sand from a sand silo, two employees were burned when a flash fire/explosion occurred. They were hospitalized with face and hand burns.

EventTitle: Explosion  unspecified
text: An employee was lighting a tankless water heater when an explosion occurred and the employee was burned.

EventTitle: Ignition of clothing from controlled heat source
text: An employee was burning excess cardboard boxes when a gust of wind blew the flames toward him. His shirt caught fire and he suffered second degree burns.

EventTitle: Fall on same level due to tripping over an object
text: An employee was using the scanner, tripped over the scanner cord and fell fracturing a hip.

EventTitle: Fall, slip, trip, unspecified
text: An employee lost his footing while walking down the stairs and sustained a right ankle fracture requiring hospitalization.

EventTitle: Fall through surface or existing opening, unspecified
text: An employee was walking on a roof when they stepped on insulation and fell through the roof to the ground below. The employee struck a welding unit on the ground and sustained a broken leg.

EventTitle: Fall on same level due to tripping on uneven surface
text: An employee was walking in the area filling drink orders and tripped over a loose floor tile. The employee fell and broke their right leg.

EventTitle: Other fall to lower level 11 to 15 feet
text: An employee was welding laps on a commercial roof. The employee slipped and fell about 13 feet, suffering a broken humerus, broken rib, broken spinal wing, and pelvic fractures.

EventTitle: Other fall to lower level, unspecified
text: An employee fell off a ladder after being startled by an electrical short and suffered head injuries and a broken collarbone.

EventTitle: Other fall to lower level, unspecified
text: An employee was stocking merchandise from a step ladder or a rolling staircase when he missed a step and fell to the floor, injuring his left hip. He was hospitalized.

EventTitle: Other fall to lower level less than 6 feet
text: An employee was exiting the office through a door and going down steps into the courtyard when she fell as she approached the last step, breaking her left ankle. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

EventTitle: Fall on same level, n.e.c.
text: An employee had just finished giving a resident a shower. When she stepped out, she twisted her left ankle and fell. She was hospitalized and required surgery.

EventTitle: Fall on same level due to slipping
text: An employee slipped on a patch of ice in the parking lot and fell to the ground, landing on his hip. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left hip.

EventTitle: Contact with hot objects or substances
text: An employee was removing a solidified plastic plug from the plastic injection port of a molding machine when pieces of hot plastic contacted the employee's skin, causing thermal burns to the right forearm.

EventTitle: Exposure through unintentional needlestick or sharp injury
text: An employee sustained an adverse reaction to prescribed medication after a needlestick.

EventTitle: Exposure to change in water pressure
text: An employee was diving for sea cucumbers at a depth of approximately 70 feet. After completing the dive, they began to feel numbness in their legs and were hospitalized for decompression sickness.

EventTitle: Direct exposure to electricity, unspecified
text: An employee entered an enclosed substation to get a tool. An arc flash caused second-degree burns to the employee's hands and arms. The employee was hospitalized.

EventTitle: Direct exposure to electricity, unspecified
text: An engineering technician was testing an electrical panel when an arc flash occurred, resulting in burns to the arm and hand.

EventTitle: Contact with hot objects or substances
text: An employee was pumping overflowing process water when they stepped in an open hole containing hot process water, resulting in second-degree burns to their ankle.

EventTitle: Contact with hot objects or substances
text: While working in a steam vault, an employee suffered second-degree burns from a release of steam.

EventTitle: Exposure to environmental heat
text: An employee became dehydrated (suffering illness, cramping, and a headache) while picking oranges. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

EventTitle: Exposure to environmental heat  outdoor
text: An employee began experiencing hand and arm cramping while climbing a tower. About an hour later, the employee became ill. The employee was hospitalized for heat-related illness.

EventTitle: Direct exposure to electricity, greater than 220 volts
text: An employee had left a roof during a lightning storm and was entering his work van. Lightning struck the ground and the employee was shocked as he entered the van.

EventTitle: Needlestick without exposure to harmful substance
text: An employee was cleaning needles used to inject an animal antibiotic into cattle when the needle punctured his left thumb.

EventTitle: Struck by running powered equipment  during maintenance, cleaning, testing
text: An employee was adjusting a cover on a chain and roller to a pipe rack roller. The employee's right index finger was caught and lacerated between the chain and the sprocket.

EventTitle: Injured by object handled by person  n.e.c.
text: An employee was cutting onions with an onion chopper and amputated the tip of his left thumb.

EventTitle: Caught in running equipment or machinery during regular operation
text: An employee was grinding a point on a steel wedge when the grinder pulled the employee's left thumb in and amputated the tip.

EventTitle: Contact with objects and equipment, unspecified
text: A coil was being lowered onto a de-coiler. An employee was trying to remove a label and was struck by the coil, suffering a broken right foot.

EventTitle: Struck by running powered equipment  during maintenance, cleaning, testing
text: A maintenance technician was cleaning a piece of equipment that is used to pump grease when their hand became caught between a pulley and belt on the equipment. The employee sustained a right middle fingertip amputation.

EventTitle: Caught in running equipment or machinery during regular operation
text: An employee was rolling a piece of steel in a roller and caught his right pinky finger in the roller. The fingertip was amputated.

EventTitle: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment
text: An employee was making adjustments to a chain conveyor with a come-along when the chain slipped and caught the employee's left hand, amputating the middle fingertip at the nailbed.

EventTitle: Injured by object pushed or pulled by person
text: Ab employee was moving a tool cart when his left hand became caught between the cart and a door frame. The employee sustained an open fracture of the hand.

EventTitle: Caught in running equipment or machinery, unspecified
text: A temporary employee was straightening a part in a hydraulic press. The press was activated and the employee's left middle and ring fingers were amputated at the first knuckle.

EventTitle: Boarding, alighting-excluding slip, trip, fall-single episode
text: While getting out of his truck, an employee misstepped and re-injured a previous hernia in his left lower abdomen.

EventTitle: Overexertion in lifting-single episode
text: An employee suffered injuries to the left shoulder, neck, and back while lifting a child. She was hospitalized.

EventTitle: Overexertion in holding, carrying, or wielding-single episode
text: An employee was carrying a box of lettuce from the delivery truck to the walk-in cooler when the employee experienced pain in the right hip/nerve damage.

EventTitle: Bending, crawling, reaching, twisting-single episode
text: An employee was attempting to remove sheets of cardboard from a feed conveyor when he suffered acute lower back pain, requiring overnight hospitalization.

EventTitle: Overexertion in pushing, pulling, or turning-single episode
text: An employee was using a pipe wrench to loosen a part in a vise. When the wrench moved, the employee's thigh muscles were torn at both knees. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

EventTitle: Overexertion involving outside sources, unspecified
text: An employee was moving a stuck 80-pound cart filled with milk. He suffered a muscle strain and went to the hospital, where he was diagnosed with a collapsed lung.

EventTitle: Multiple types of exertions and bodily reactions
text: While performing physical conditioning and training to prepare for forest work conditions, an employee became ill and suffered muscle injury.

EventTitle: Walking, without other incident-single episode
text: An employee pushing a cart felt a snap and pain in the hip. The employee's prosthetic hip broke, and the employee required hospitalization.

EventTitle: Overexertion in lifting-single episode
text: An employee was helping a patient get into position for an MRI. While moving the patient, the employee heard/felt a "pop" in the lower right side of her back. She was hospitalized.

EventTitle: Bending, crawling, reaching, twisting-single episode
text: An employee was performing internal maintenance on a waste sorting machine and sustained a back injury while attempting to crawl out of the tight space.
